intro: Trying to find Michigan scholarships in the USA with awards under a common upper range usually means balancing budget, fit, and timing at the same time. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings tied to Michigan, with options that touch areas such as education, community, STEM, disability, medicine, and more. You can compare programs for different study levels, including high school seniors, undergraduates, graduate students, community college paths, and trade school applicants. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ across the rows, and requirements are not identical, so it helps to read each entry closely. Some listings may be lighter-touch than others, but you should still verify eligibility, essay expectations, and residency details on the official scholarship page before you apply.

supporting: A useful way to read this list is to compare more than the headline amount.
